metadata.title: BC Forest Service timeline — events for the atlas

source.title: BC Forest Service Centenary Society — BC Forest Service Timeline (compiled by John Parminter)

metadata.method: Of the timeline’s 299 entries (1778–2005), those about a body the atlas draws — a ministry of the day, a Crown corporation, a sub-agency — are kept, with the timeline’s own cited source in each locator. Industry, federal and legislative entries not about such a body are left out. Where the timeline disagrees with a date the atlas holds, both are kept and the note says so; nothing here sets a start or end.

events.title: Small Business Forest Enterprise Program — dated 1979 by the BC Forest Service timeline

evidence.source_title: BC Forest Service Centenary Society — BC Forest Service Timeline (compiled by John Parminter)
evidence.locator: Timeline entry dated 1979: “Small Business Forest Enterprise Program.” — citing Grist

events.notes: A secondary compilation. The program’s start is unresolved in the sub-agency review, which declined to promote a 1988 regulation to its establishment; this is a lead to check against the 1978 Forest Act and Ministry of Forests annual reports, not a start date.

events.title: Forest Renewal BC terminated, 14 June 2002, replaced by the Forest Investment Account

evidence.source_title: BC Forest Service Centenary Society — BC Forest Service Timeline (compiled by John Parminter)
evidence.locator: Timeline entry dated 2002: “Forest Renewal BC terminated on June 14 and replaced with the Forest Investment Account to focus on land-based improvements and studies, forestry research, product development, and international marketing.” — citing The State of Canada’s Forests, 2001-2002

events.notes: The atlas’s body record ends Forest Renewal BC on 27 June 2002; the timeline gives 14 June. Both are kept until a primary source settles it.

leads: Forestry Innovation Investment: incorporated 31 March 2003 per the timeline — confirm and set as its start.
Small Business Forest Enterprise Program: 1979 per the timeline — check against the 1978 Forest Act and Ministry of Forests annual reports.
Commission on Resources and Environment (1992, by statute of June 1992) is not in the atlas as a body.
